title: If Your Principal Starts Growing Taller During An Assembly... GET OUT
description:
If your principal ever starts growing taller during a school assembly... get out. Don't clap when he asks you to. Don't stand up to applaud. And whatever you do, don't let him see that you're afraid. There are 7 rules. The third one is why most people don't make it out

This is an analog horror survival guide for a Friday afternoon assembly at your school: a principal whose head is almost touching the top of the stage curtains, a suit jacket splitting down the back, a microphone pinched between two enormous fingers, a crack in the gym ceiling, a hand closing around the bleacher railing, three quick claps near the exit, an intercom that knows your full name, one eye staring down through the ceiling tiles, a live assembly broadcast, a row of crushed benches, and a mandatory assembly tommorow at 9:00 AM

FILE 088 - PRINCIPAL. Issued by the Department of Domestic Entities. Please listen to all steps.

CHAPTERS
0:00 If your principal starts growing taller
1:15 Rule 1: If your principal starts growing, stop clapping
2:41 Rule 2: If he reaches into the bleachers, get away from his hands
4:28 Rule 3: If he calls your name, don't answer
5:52 Rule 5: If the ceiling starts breaking, don't stay under it
7:34 Rule 5: If the intercom asks you to applaud, don't liste
9:37 Rule 6: If he starts falling toward you, get outside
11:22 Part 7: [classified]

ABOUT THESE FILES
Every file is one ordinary thing that stops acting ordinary, and the short list of rules that gets you home. No explanations. Just instructions.

Yes, it's fiction. The Department does not exist, and no principal has ever grown taller than a school. In real life, if anything ever goes wrong during an assembly, stay calm, listen to your teachers and walk to the nearest marked exit without pushing. Everything else in this file is made up. All animation and sound effects are original; the music adapts Elgar's "Pomp and Circumstance" (public domain).

title: If Your Bed is Ever Already Warm... GET OUT SLOWLY
description:
You haven't been in your room all evening. Nobody has. The door's been closed. But when you slide under the covers, the sheets are warm. Not a little warm. Body warm.

If your bed is ever already warm when you get in, don't jump up. Don't turn on the light. And don't reach across to the other side of the mattress. Follow these five rules, and whatever you do, never put your hand on the warm spot.

And if your bed is ever cold when you get in... watch to the end.

title: What If Your CRUSH Become Your TUTOR?
description:
My crush became my math tutor... and she was NOT who I thought she was. 💜📚

You failed your math test so badly that your mom hired a tutor. The problem? The tutor is Violet — the smartest, sweetest, most perfect girl in school... and your crush.

But behind that straight-A smile, Violet is a total menace. She steals your snacks, beats you at video games, turns your wallpaper into a shirtless old man riding a dolphin — and she's hiding a secret nobody at school knows about.

One test. One secret. One note written in purple ink.

title: What If You and Your Crush Got Stuck in a Sauna?
tags: what if you and your crush got stuck in a sauna
what if you were locked in a sauna
description:
What if the door of a Finnish sauna swelled shut, with you and your crush inside, and she can't stand you? Minus thirty outside, the stones getting hotter every minute, three mouthfuls of water and one old straw hat.

Max's cabin on a frozen lake in northern Finland, a stupid bet about who leaves the sauna last, and a door that won't open. Plan A, Plan B, Plan C… and when you finally break out, your friends are gone, the cabin is locked, and the only warm window is two kilometers away through a blizzard.

Watch Part 2 here: https://youtu.be/LD29GbcRQyY

Would you have confessed in that sauna, or waited until you were safe? Tell us in the comments 👇

title: If Everyone On Your Flight Closes Their Window... DON'T LOOK OUTSIDE
description:
If everyone on your flgiht suddenly closes their window shade at the exact same time... don't look outside. Don't open your shade. Don't answer the voice at your window. And whatever you do, don't let the other airplane see you looking. There are 7 rules. Most people break the third one.

This is an analog horror survival guide for the night every passenger on your flight closes their window at once: the man acorss the aisle who laughed and opened his, the tapping that checks every window down the cabin, the seat-change slip with your seat number on it, the passenger beside you who starts moving before you do, the screaming behind the galley curtain, the other airplane flying right beside yours with the same flight number, the radio call that says your flight landed forty minutes ago, and the security footage of you smiling at the camera.

FILE 077 - FLIGHT. Issued by the Department of Domestic Entities. Please listen to all steps.

CHAPTERS 
0:00 If everyone on your flight closes their windows
0:56 Rule 1: Keep your window shade closed 
1:56 Rule 2: If the flgiht attendant asks you to change seats, say no
2:55 Rule 3: If the person beside you starts copying you, move away
4:09 Rule 4: If you hear screaming from the back, don't go looking
5:22 Rule 5: If you see another airplane, don't let it see you looking
6:39 Rule 6: If the captain says you already landed, stay in your seat
7:38 Rule 7: Police 
9:59 The phone call

ABOUT THESE FILES
Every file is one ordinary thing that stops acting ordinary, and the short list of rules that gets you to morning. No explanations. Just instructions.

Yes, it's fiction. The Department does not exist. In real life, crews ask for window shades to be open during takeoff and landing, so everyone on board can see outside if something goes wrong. Everything else in the file is made up. All animation, music and sound effects are original.

title: What If You Were Reborn as Your Own Grandchild?
description:
You were 80 years old. You closed your eyes in your favorite armchair during your least favorite game show… and opened them in a hospital. Tiny. Bald. Wrapped in a blanket. And the woman holding you is your own daughter 👶👴

She names you Walter. After her dad. After YOU.

Now you live in your old house on Maple Street with eighty years of memories and no way to say a single word. The ketchup guy your daughter married is your dad now. He sits in YOUR chair. He puts ketchup on the chili. Your daughter forgot the secret ingredient. And all you can do is frown, reach for reading glasses that aren’t there, and say “hmph” 😤

But babies hear everything. And when people think you can’t understand, they finally say what they never told you… 💭

There’s one thing your daughter got wrong about you. The truth is hidden in a dented recipe tin, and on Saturday at 9 AM it’s going on a donation truck forever. 🚚 You can’t talk. You can’t walk. You can’t even crawl… yet. ⏰

If you could hear what your family really thinks of you, would you want to? And is there something you’d tell them today, before you forget? ❤️

title: What If You Could See Your Future Wife?
description:
Above every girl in your classroom there's a tag. It tells you how she fits into your future. Harper: FRIEND. Tiffany, queen of the school: FUTURE EX-WIFE. And Raven Blackwood, the coldest girl in school, who has never said one word to you: FUTURE WIFE, 99%.

What if you could see your future wife? You can see everyone's tags within a hundred meters: who they'll love, who they'll lose, who's lying. You simulate a marriage with Tiffany and end up broke, in the rain, in your socks. You simulate a future with Raven and see a billion-dollar life — then she tells you to get lost, and 99% drops to 45%. Three locks stand between you and her. Seventeen days. And at midnight on the night of the spring dance, her father announces her engagement to someone else.

Would you want to see your future wife, or would you rather be surprised? Tell us in the comments.

Subscribe to DOOMPERK for more animated What If stories.

title: What If You Could See Everyone’s Love Meter?
description:
What if you could see a number above everyone’s head showing exactly how much they love you? 💘

You’ve never met this woman in your life...watch to find out what happens.
